meta.purpose: LLM-only contextual patterns requiring judgment and reasoning
meta.integration_note: Use only when code patterns trigger LLM analysis need

gojko_behavior_change.description: Contextual analysis of behavior change focus using Gojko Adzic principles
gojko_behavior_change.analysis_focus: Does this describe one specific behavior change or multiple?
reasoning_prompts: Would a user see this as one coherent action or multiple separate actions?
If this story fails, would it fail for one reason or multiple reasons?
Can this be independently valuable without other stories?

confidence_indicators.high_confidence: Clear compound behaviors with distinct outcomes
confidence_indicators.medium_confidence: Sequential actions that might be single workflow

invest_independence_judgment.description: Contextual assessment of story independence beyond keyword detection
invest_independence_judgment.analysis_focus: Can this story be developed, tested, and delivered independently?
reasoning_prompts: Does this story have hidden dependencies not captured by keywords?
Would a new team member understand this without other story context?
Can this be tested without requiring other stories to be implemented first?
context_considerations: Domain-specific terminology that might imply dependencies

smart_achievability_assessment.description: Contextual judgment of story achievability within team constraints
smart_achievability_assessment.analysis_focus: Is this realistically achievable with current team and constraints?
reasoning_prompts: Does this require skills or technology not available to the team?
Are there external dependencies that could block completion?
Is the scope realistic for the timeframe implied?

smart_relevance_alignment.description: Contextual assessment of story relevance to user/business goals
smart_relevance_alignment.analysis_focus: How does this align with user needs and business objectives?
reasoning_prompts: Who specifically benefits from this story and how?
What user problem does this solve or business goal does this advance?
Would users notice and value this change?

story_mapping_journey_coherence.description: Contextual analysis of story fit within user journeys
story_mapping_journey_coherence.analysis_focus: Does this story fit within a coherent user journey?
reasoning_prompts: What user journey does this story support?
What would a user do before and after this story?
Does this create a logical step in a larger workflow?
journey_assessment: Connects to preceding and following activities
Supports complete workflow vs isolated task

story_mapping_value_prioritization.description: Contextual evaluation of story value alignment with journey criticality
story_mapping_value_prioritization.analysis_focus: Does story value align with user journey criticality?
reasoning_prompts: Is this story critical for the core user journey?
Would users be blocked or frustrated without this?
Does this enable key user outcomes vs nice-to-have features?

impact_mapping_goal_alignment.description: Contextual assessment of story connection to business goals
impact_mapping_goal_alignment.analysis_focus: How does this story connect to specific business goals?
reasoning_prompts: What business goal does this story advance?
How will success be measured?
What behavior change will achieve the goal?

impact_mapping_actor_behavior.description: Contextual analysis of actor identification and behavior change
impact_mapping_actor_behavior.analysis_focus: Who are the specific actors and why do they want this?
reasoning_prompts: Who specifically will use this feature and in what context?
What motivates this actor to want this behavior change?
How will this change their current behavior or workflow?

three_cs_conversation_enablement.description: Contextual assessment of whether story enables productive conversation
three_cs_conversation_enablement.analysis_focus: Does this enable productive conversation about requirements?
reasoning_prompts: What questions would a developer ask about this story?
Are there implicit assumptions that need clarification?
What aspects need discussion vs specification?

definition_of_ready_completeness.description: Contextual assessment of story readiness beyond checklist items
definition_of_ready_completeness.analysis_focus: Is this story truly ready for development work?
reasoning_prompts: Would a developer know where to start with this story?
Are there hidden complexities not captured in acceptance criteria?
Does the team have shared understanding of what done means?

analysis_approach.context_first: Consider domain context and business process knowledge
analysis_approach.user_perspective: Evaluate from user and developer perspectives
analysis_approach.confidence_calibration: Adjust confidence based on context clarity

response_format.structured_analysis: Provide reasoning, conclusion, and confidence level
response_format.framework_reference: Identify which framework principle was applied
response_format.decision_rationale: Explain why this requires human vs AI judgment

high_confidence_0.82_to_0.85: Clear contextual violations with domain knowledge
medium_confidence_0.75_to_0.82: Partial alignment with some framework principles

integration_strategy.code_triggers_llm: Use LLM analysis only when code patterns indicate need
integration_strategy.focused_framework_selection: Apply only relevant frameworks, not all simultaneously
integration_strategy.contextual_enhancement: Use domain knowledge to inform analysis
integration_strategy.human_decision_points: Present analysis for human judgment, don't auto-fix
